notes.title: Update 07/27/2020
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone that has purchased and wishlisted the game! Launch week has been very exciting and it wouldn’t be without your support and feedback! 

A lot of progress was made this week thanks to feedback from players. Below is a list of updates and fixes from this week. 

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where the first player could accelerate the second player’s jetpack after continuing the game.

[*] Fixed issue where bullets from the Orca weapon were colliding with the player when shooting downwards. 

[*] Fixed issue where you can fly out of the map in level 2.

[*] Fixed issue where you could reach the end of level 2 without defeating the boss.

[*] Fixed issue where loading into level 3 causes a fatal error. (Played though a few times without error. Please let me know if you encounter this again.) 

[*] Fixed issue where weapons would not switch properly after continuing the game. 

[*] Fixed issue where using the jetpack was not sending feedback to the HUD.

[*] Headshots are now a bit easier. 
[/list]

Once again, thanks so much for taking a chance on my game and helping me to make it better!
More Soon!
